messages.subject: convergence problem for the variance in Gaussian Process.
parts: I am new in stan. I am trying to wrote a model for Gaussian process and all the parameters converge except the variance.Can anyone advice me where is the problem ? I used squared exponential kernel and also used AR(1) kernel.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] convergence problem for the variance in Gaussian Process.
parts:
Only catching up with some of these old ones now. When you say
it doesn't converge, what happens in the output and how many iterations
have you run? I'm not a GP expert, but you may want to try tighter
priors than the Cauchy's.

Also, you want to vectorize all those calls to multi_normal!

- Bob
